rules.text: Turn FillCorners and FillCornersRecursive on so concave corners box out.
rules.appliesWhen: all assets except ones deliberately meant to keep a natural, organic shape (rocks, terrain, foliage, clouds)

rules.text: Set Symmetry to X and leave ForceMirror off, so the geometry is mirror-symmetric across the left/right axis while colour is not forced to match across it.
rules.appliesWhen: humans, animals, and other creatures, unless the description implies a deliberately asymmetric feature (an eyepatch, a raised paw, a one-sided marking)

rules.text: Set ColourMode to Consolidated and set ConsolidateMaxColours to the number of distinct colours the description implies.
Set FineFactor to 3 for small objects with fine features, otherwise 2.
Set ColWeight to 2 for objects with strong colour detail or hard colour boundaries, otherwise 1.

Set ResolutionInput to WorldSize with VoxelWorldSize 0.1, and set TargetWorldSize to your best estimate of the object's longest real-world dimension in metres (a mug ~0.12, a chair ~1, a car ~4, a house ~8).
